purpose: Regress the unchanged E35 semantic candidate against the four user-corrected development cases and separately verify whether it emits a rooted content map.

user_reviewed_acceptance.content_map_requirement: Emit actual rooted expansion nodes; capacity-axis labels alone do not qualify.

case_results.diagnosis: The model replaced the fruit object with seller retail and ordinary buyer consumption. Its axes focused on display, pricing, loss control, selection, and eating rather than the complete fruit world.
The model retained gold material and seller processing in both candidate roots. It approached gifting but did not recover the broader gift object or gifting and human-relations world.

case_results.audience_world: 海鲜产地实况与市场行情
case_results.diagnosis: The model reproduced the rejected source-operation, B/C, supply, price, selection, and trust templates and omitted seafood itself as a candidate root.

case_results.object_world: 重庆火锅风味还原与延伸
case_results.diagnosis: The model let regional flavor and one family-use scene narrow the complete hotpot world. Plain hotpot was not recalled as a candidate.

root_cause.prompt_bias: Actions, uses, and long-term needs receive repeated positive attention, so the model promotes them over complete object worlds even when the object is the larger valid content root.
root_cause.contract_gap: The candidate contract stores only capacity-axis labels and does not require actual content-map nodes under the selected root.
root_cause.evaluation_learning: System-authored unseen labels in E35 were insufficient to establish alignment with the user's marketing semantics. User-reviewed development regressions remain mandatory alongside unseen generalization cases.

retained_target.semantic_migration: Generate competing content-subject candidates from object hierarchy, use, action, relation, result, culture, and other relevant directions without granting any direction priority.
retained_target.selection: The Lead chooses the largest effective content world that remains specific enough to return naturally to the business.
retained_target.content_map: Expand actual nodes from the selected root across applicable vertical, horizontal, temporal, spatial, cultural, character, event, conflict, and cross-domain dimensions.
